fields.name: Nursing care
fields.work: Help elderly or disabled people with daily life in care homes and day-care centres: bathing, meals, moving, toilets, recreation and record-keeping.
fields.skills_test: Nursing Care Skills Evaluation Test (介護技能評価試験)
fields.extra_language_test: Nursing Care Japanese Language Evaluation Test (介護日本語評価試験)
fields.ssw2_note: No SSW (ii) in this field. The long-term route is the national Certified Care Worker exam (介護福祉士), which leads to the Care Worker (介護) visa.
fields.japanese_tip: Talking with residents every day, so Japanese matters more than in most fields. Aim for N3 after arriving.
fields.shifts: Day, evening and night shifts are common.

fields.name: Building cleaning
fields.work: Clean the inside of offices, hotels, hospitals and stations: floors, toilets, windows and carpets, using professional machines and chemicals.
fields.skills_test: Building Cleaning Skills Evaluation Test (ビルクリーニング分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Safety words and chemical labels are the key Japanese to learn.
fields.shifts: Early-morning and night work is common, when buildings are empty.

fields.name: Industrial manufacturing
fields.work: Work in factories making metal parts, machinery, electrical and electronic products: machining, welding, assembly, painting, inspection and packing.
fields.skills_test: Manufacturing Skills Evaluation Test (製造分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Learn safety signs and the 5S words (整理・整頓・清掃・清潔・しつけ) early.
fields.shifts: Two- or three-shift rotations are common in larger factories.

fields.name: Construction
fields.work: Building sites and civil engineering: formwork, rebar, scaffolding, interior finishing, plumbing, electrical work and heavy machinery, depending on your specialty.
fields.skills_test: Construction Skills Evaluation Test (建設分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Morning safety meetings (朝礼) and danger warnings must be understood from day one.
fields.shifts: Mostly daytime, outdoors; start early in the morning.

fields.name: Shipbuilding & marine industry
fields.work: Build and fit out ships and marine equipment: welding, painting, ironwork, finishing, machinery fitting and electrical work.
fields.skills_test: Shipbuilding and Marine Industry Skills Test (造船・舶用工業分野特定技能1号試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Welding and safety vocabulary is the priority.
fields.shifts: Mostly daytime, in shipyards along the coast.

fields.name: Automobile repair
fields.work: Inspect, service and repair cars at garages and dealers, including the regular vehicle inspection (車検).
fields.skills_test: Automobile Repair Skills Evaluation Test (自動車整備分野特定技能評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Customer explanations and parts names; the national mechanic certificate is a big plus later.
fields.shifts: Daytime, with busy seasons around 車検 and tyre changes.

fields.name: Aviation
fields.work: Airport ground handling (guiding aircraft, loading baggage and cargo) or aircraft maintenance support.
fields.skills_test: Aviation Skills Evaluation Test (航空分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Radio and safety phrases are fixed patterns — learn them by heart.
fields.shifts: Early-morning and late-night shifts follow flight schedules.

fields.name: Accommodation (hotels & ryokan)
fields.work: Front desk, planning, guest service and restaurant service at hotels and ryokan. Room cleaning can be part of the job but not the only task.
fields.skills_test: Accommodation Industry Skills Test (宿泊分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Polite customer language (敬語) matters; your own language is a plus with foreign guests.
fields.shifts: Early, late and night shifts are common.
words: しょうしょうおまちください

fields.name: Agriculture
fields.work: Growing crops (vegetables, fruit, rice, greenhouse farming) or raising livestock (dairy, pigs, poultry).
fields.skills_test: Agriculture Skills Evaluation Test (農業技能測定試験) — crop or livestock
fields.japanese_tip: Rural areas: local dialect and fewer English speakers, so everyday Japanese helps a lot.
fields.shifts: Seasonal; early mornings. SSW agriculture can be through dispatch agencies for seasonal work.

fields.name: Fishery & aquaculture
fields.work: Work on fishing boats or at fish and seaweed farms: nets, catching, sorting and processing on board.
fields.skills_test: Fishery Skills Evaluation Test (漁業技能測定試験) — fishing or aquaculture
fields.japanese_tip: Safety at sea and weather words are essential.
fields.shifts: Depends on season and the boat; can mean long trips.

fields.name: Food & beverage manufacturing
fields.work: Make and pack food and drinks in factories: bento, bread, sweets, prepared foods, meat and fish processing. Strict hygiene rules.
fields.skills_test: Food and Beverage Manufacturing Skills Test (飲食料品製造業特定技能1号技能測定試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Hygiene (衛生) rules and HACCP words come first.
fields.shifts: Early-morning and night lines are common, especially for fresh food.

fields.name: Food service (restaurants)
fields.work: Cooking, serving customers and running the shop at restaurants, cafés and fast-food chains.
fields.skills_test: Food Service Industry Skills Test (外食業特定技能1号技能測定試験)
fields.japanese_tip: Fixed customer phrases (いらっしゃいませ, かしこまりました) plus kitchen words.
fields.shifts: Lunch and dinner peaks; evenings and weekends are busy.

fields.name: Automobile transportation (truck, taxi, bus)
fields.work: Drive trucks, taxis or buses. A Japanese driving licence of the right class is required, and passenger work (taxi, bus) needs a second-class licence.
fields.skills_test: Automobile Transportation Skills Test (自動車運送業分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.language_note: Taxi and bus driving require a higher Japanese level (around N3) than the usual N4.
fields.ssw2_note: Added in 2024; SSW (ii) is not available in this field at the time of writing.
fields.japanese_tip: Road signs, navigation and talking with passengers or customers.
fields.shifts: Long hours and night driving are common; check working-hour rules carefully.

fields.name: Railway
fields.work: Track and power-line maintenance, rolling-stock maintenance and manufacturing, or station and train operations support.
fields.skills_test: Railway Skills Evaluation Test (鉄道分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.language_note: Station and train-crew work requires a higher Japanese level (around N3).
fields.ssw2_note: Added in 2024; SSW (ii) is not available in this field at the time of writing.
fields.japanese_tip: Safety procedures and fixed calls (指差喚呼 — point-and-call) are key.
fields.shifts: Track work often happens at night when trains stop.

fields.name: Forestry
fields.work: Planting, thinning and cutting trees, and moving logs in mountain forests, using chainsaws and forestry machines.
fields.skills_test: Forestry Skills Evaluation Test (林業分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.ssw2_note: Added in 2024; SSW (ii) is not available in this field at the time of writing.
fields.japanese_tip: Danger warnings shouted in the forest must be understood instantly.
fields.shifts: Outdoor daytime work in mountain areas; weather-dependent.

fields.name: Wood industry
fields.work: Sawmills and wood-product factories: cutting, drying, processing and finishing timber and plywood.
fields.skills_test: Wood Industry Skills Evaluation Test (木材産業分野特定技能1号評価試験)
fields.ssw2_note: Added in 2024; SSW (ii) is not available in this field at the time of writing.
